req.title: Retrieve all players
req.statement: The system shall respond to GET /players with a JSON array of all players in the database.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states GET /players/ must return HTTP 200 and a JSON array of all Player objects. I design: (1) a positive EP test verifying exact count=26, exact status=200, and spot-checking known field values from the pre-loaded fixture; (2) a negative NEG test verifying that an unsupported HTTP method (POST with no body) returns 422 not 200, and that DELETE on the collection returns 405; (3) a BVA boundary test verifying the response is a non-empty list with exactly 26 items (boundary: list length == 26, not 25 or 27), and that each item contains all required PlayerResponseModel fields including 'id'; (4) a DT decision-table test verifying cache header behaviour (X-Cache: MISS on first call, HIT on second call); (5) a STC state-transition test verifying that after a POST creates a new player the GET /players/ count increments by exactly 1 to 27. All tests use fastapi.testclient.TestClient in-process, assert exact values, and are idempotent given the fixture reset guarantee.

FastAPI app is running in-process via TestClient
expected: Response body is a JSON array

Squad number 1 player has firstName 'Anjali' and lastName 'Banerjee'
trace: R-PLAYER-001: GET /players/ returns HTTP 200 and JSON array of all players
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_get_all_players_returns_200_and_26_players():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get('/players/')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.json()
    assert isinstance(data, list)
    assert len(data) == 26
    required_fields = {'id', 'firstName', 'lastName', 'squadNumber', 'position'}
    for player in data:
        for field in required_fields:
            assert field in player, f'Missing field: {field}'
    squad1 = next((p for p in data if p['squadNumber'] == 1), None)
    assert squad1 is not None
    assert squad1['firstName'] == 'Anjali'
    assert squad1['lastName'] == 'Banerjee'
    squad26 = next((p for p in data if p['squadNumber'] == 26), None)
    assert squad26 is not None
    assert squad26['firstName'] == 'Aditya'
    assert squad26['lastName'] == 'Mehta'

test_get_all_players_returns_200_and_26_players()

    client = TestClient(app)

from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_get_all_players_exact_count_boundary_26():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get('/players/')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.json()
    assert len(data) == 26
    assert len(data) != 25
    assert len(data) != 27
    squad_numbers = [p['squadNumber'] for p in data]
    assert 1 in squad_numbers
    assert 26 in squad_numbers
    assert 0 not in squad_numbers
    assert 27 not in squad_numbers
    assert min(squad_numbers) == 1
    assert max(squad_numbers) == 26

tests.name: test_get_all_players_cache_header_miss_then_hit
preconditions: Database is pre-loaded with exactly 26 player rows
Cache is cold (first request after fixture reset)
actions: Send first GET /players/ — expect X-Cache: MISS
Send second GET /players/ — expect X-Cache: HIT
Both responses must return 200 and identical data
trace: R-PLAYER-001: DT — cache decision table: cold cache -> MISS, warm cache -> HIT
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from routes.player_route import simple_memory_cache, CACHE_KEY
import asyncio

def test_get_all_players_cache_header_miss_then_hit():
    asyncio.get_event_loop().run_until_complete(simple_memory_cache.clear(CACHE_KEY))
    client = TestClient(app)
    r1 = client.get('/players/')
    assert r1.status_code == 200
    assert r1.headers.get('X-Cache') == 'MISS'
    data1 = r1.json()
    assert len(data1) == 26
    r2 = client.get('/players/')
    assert r2.status_code == 200
    assert r2.headers.get('X-Cache') == 'HIT'
    data2 = r2.json()
    assert len(data2) == 26
    ids1 = sorted(p['id'] for p in data1)
    ids2 = sorted(p['id'] for p in data2)
    assert ids1 == ids2

test_get_all_players_cache_header_miss_then_hit()

tests.name: test_get_all_players_count_increments_after_post
preconditions: Database is pre-loaded with exactly 26 player rows
Squad number 99 does not exist in the database
actions: POST /players/ with a new valid player (squadNumber=99)
expected: New player with squadNumber=99 appears in the second GET response
trace: R-PLAYER-001: STC — state transition: 26 players -> POST -> 27 players reflected in GET /players/
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from routes.player_route import simple_memory_cache, CACHE_KEY
import asyncio

def test_get_all_players_count_increments_after_post():
    asyncio.get_event_loop().run_until_complete(simple_memory_cache.clear(CACHE_KEY))
    client = TestClient(app)
    r1 = client.get('/players/')
    assert r1.status_code == 200
    assert len(r1.json()) == 26
    new_player = {
        'firstName': 'Test', 'lastName': 'Player',
        'squadNumber': 99, 'position': 'Goalkeeper'
    }
    rp = client.post('/players/', json=new_player)
    assert rp.status_code == 201
    r2 = client.get('/players/')
    assert r2.status_code == 200
    data2 = r2.json()
    assert len(data2) == 27
    assert len(data2) != 26
    squad99 = next((p for p in data2 if p['squadNumber'] == 99), None)
    assert squad99 is not None
    assert squad99['firstName'] == 'Test'
    client.delete('/players/squadnumber/99')

test_get_all_players_count_increments_after_post()

tests.name: test_get_all_players_each_object_has_exact_fields
preconditions: Database is pre-loaded with exactly 26 player rows
actions: For each player object verify all PlayerResponseModel fields are present
Spot-check specific known values for squad 10 (Kabir Mary Reddy)
expected: Every player object has keys: id, firstName, lastName, squadNumber, position
Optional fields middleName, dateOfBirth, abbrPosition, team, league, starting11 present
Squad 10 player: firstName=Kabir, middleName=Mary, lastName=Reddy, position=Right Winger, team=River Plate, league=Ligue 1, starting11=false
trace: R-PLAYER-001: EP — each Player object in array conforms to PlayerResponseModel schema
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_get_all_players_each_object_has_exact_fields():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get('/players/')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.json()
    assert len(data) == 26
    all_keys = {
        'id','firstName','lastName','squadNumber','position',
        'middleName','dateOfBirth','abbrPosition','team','league','starting11'
    }
    for player in data:
        for key in all_keys:
            assert key in player, f'Missing key {key} in player {player}'
    p10 = next((p for p in data if p['squadNumber'] == 10), None)
    assert p10 is not None
    assert p10['firstName'] == 'Kabir'
    assert p10['middleName'] == 'Mary'
    assert p10['lastName'] == 'Reddy'
    assert p10['position'] == 'Right Winger'
    assert p10['team'] == 'River Plate'
    assert p10['league'] == 'Ligue 1'
    assert p10['starting11'] == False

test_get_all_players_each_object_has_exact_fields()
